**Vera Slyk** is a patient representative serving on the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Committee) for the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen) [^src1]. In this governance role, she is responsible for ensuring that the patient perspective and user involvement are actively integrated into the development of clinical quality indicators and treatment standards [^src1]. 

Her participation in the Steering Committee is documented in the 2025 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database [^src1]. This report outlines the organizational governance of the database and addresses broader systemic barriers to quality measurement in acute surgery. These systemic challenges include difficulties with data registration, uncertainties regarding indicator definitions, and the need to adjust quality targets to account for the varying functions and patient demographics across different hospitals and regions [^src1]. Through her position on the committee, Slyk contributes to the multidisciplinary and regional initiatives working to overcome these barriers and improve the quality of acute surgical care [^src1].
